criteria.statement: Workers page renders fleet summary counts for total, open, reduced, cleanup_only, and blocked workers.
Workers page supports filters for capacity class, pressure level, and recommended action.
Worker rows display pressure, capacity class, recommended action, and compact telemetry indicators with a no-telemetry fallback.
Worker action menu can publish worker.cleanup.request Kind 5100 with operator-selected cleanup_mode for any scheduling state.
ML placement preview rejects blocked and cleanup_only workers, penalizes reduced workers by 5000 score points, and leaves missing pressure data unpenalized.
